moat_against: Low-margin reseller economics: mix shift to large hardware deals cut Q2 2026 gross margin 70bp to 20.1%
Disintermediation risk: vendors selling direct and hyperscaler cloud marketplaces bypass the channel
Intense competition from Insight, SHI, Connection and vendor-direct channels in a fragmented market
Dependence on vendor partners, rebate terms and corporate IT spending cycles
Levered balance sheet: net debt 6.3x normalized OE on the TTM base (engine diagnostics)
moat_for: Scale: leading US IT solutions provider with 1,000+ vendor partners and reach across commercial, government, education and healthcare customers
Embedded procurement: eProcurement integration, account teams and lifecycle services create real switching friction
Services & solutions attach rising (Lovelytics data/AI acquisition closed Sep 2026 adds 600+ specialists)
Consistent buybacks shrink the share count ~1.2%/yr, supporting per-share owner's earnings
moat_justification: Scale leader in a fragmented US IT channel with deep vendor relationships, embedded procurement workflows and a growing services attach, but the core economics are low-margin reselling: vendors and cloud marketplaces can bypass the channel, competition is intense, and pricing/mix power is limited.
name: CDW Corporation
one_liner: Solid scaled IT channel leader, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $155.44 (weighted IRR 6.8%, weighted IV@15% $52.14 on the TTM base); the price would need to fall toward ~$52 for a 15% return on these inputs.
